price.quote: The main downside I keep coming back to is just the price, starting at $2,590. And that’s before adding all the fun accessories that make use of the cool Snap-On mounting system.
price.basis: May 2024 launch price; MOD now lists $1,999 regular

cls.quote: The rear motor is rated at 750W of continuous power, maxing out the legal limit in the US for street-legal e-bikes. But the peak power is even higher at 1,000W. I was able to easily hit speeds of up to 28 mph (45 km/h), though you can also limit the bike to 20 mph (32 km/h) if you want to keep it in Class 2 settings.

spd.quote: Speed | Up to 20 mph (Off-road mode: up to 28 mph)

tq.quote: Motor | MOD DRIVE 750W Geared Hub - 69 Nm of torque
The motor also claims a torque rating of 69 Nm. Nice!

wh.quote: Battery | Samsung Li-ion 48V 15Ah (720Wh) - Tested by SGS compliant to UL 2271
Battery: 48V 15Ah (720 Wh) or dual batteries for 1,440 Wh

range.basis: 50 single battery, 100 with optional second battery

range.quote: The bike’s single battery is a 48V 15Ah (720 Wh) unit, but you can double it to a maximum of 1,440 Wh. Depending on whether you double up, you’ll have 45 or 90 miles (72 or 144 km) of range. I tested the dual battery version, and if you use the throttle a lot or just want to have extra range, I’d recommend the second battery.

wt.quote: Bike Weight (w/o battery) | 72.5 lbs | Battery Weight | 7.5 lbs
Bike Weight: 62 pounds (28 kg) | Battery Weight: 7.5 pounds (3.4 kg)
wt.basis: 62 lb bike + 7.5 lb battery; the review also says '70 lb weight with a single battery'

motor.quote: Motor | MOD DRIVE 750W Geared Hub - 69 Nm of torque
Motor: 750W (1,000W peak) geared rear hub motor

fold.basis: only the stem folds; frame does not

fold.quote: Speaking of those bars, they also fold down, which is great for loading the bike in the back of a car with step-thru seating like a mini van. You just slide the bike down the center aisle, made possible thanks to the bars dropping down so low.

notes: Maker spec tables are in collapsed accordions (expanded to read). Electrek's May 2024 review calls it 'MOD Cargo' but describes the new-generation features (color display, torque sensor), so treated as CarGo 3. Weight disagrees: maker 72.5 + 7.5 = 80 lb; Electrek 62 + 7.5 = 69.5 lb. Launch price was $2,590; MOD now lists $1,999 regular ($1,799 sale). EBR has no CarGo page.
